remarks: Conveniently located in Norwalk's desirable Spring Hill neighborhood, this spacious and sun-filled 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offers comfortable, low-maintenance living. The main level features an open floor plan with hardwood floors throughout, a bright living and dining area with sliders to a private deck/balcony-ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The kitchen is appointed with updated cabinetry and newer stainless steel appliances, and a fully renovated half bath completes this level. Upstairs, the generous primary bedroom offers three closets and ample space, complemented by a second well-sized bedroom and a full bath with tub/shower. In-unit laundry on the upper level adds everyday convenience, while the attic provides additional storage. Additional highlights include crown molding, recessed lights, central air (approximately 5-year-old air handler and condenser), a newer water heater, and assigned parking (#130) with ample guest parking. Residents enjoy beautifully maintained grounds and a centrally located in-ground pool. The HOA fee of $384/month includes landscaping, snow removal, water, property management, trash, pool maintenance and insurance. Ideally situated within walking distance to Norwalk Hospital and just minutes to SONO, shopping, dining, parks, train stations, I-95 and the Merritt Parkway. A fantastic opportunity for commuters, first-time buyers, or anyone seeking a move-in ready home in a prime location. Schedule your private viewing today
